png platform phase 2.13.1

Build command:
  gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -DPNG_DEC_USE_ZLIB -O2 -I. -o test_upgrade test_upgrade.c png_*.c -lz -lm

Test command:
  ./test_upgrade

Result:
  ALL_TESTS_OK

Major additions in this phase:
  - progressive budget controls can now hard-fail with PNG_DEC_ERR_WORK_BUDGET via png_progressive_control.hard_fail_on_budget_exhaustion
  - dedicated regression tests for every new hardened-limit error code
  - fixed Adam7 progressive pass-to-pass predictor reset in the streaming decoder
  - strengthened native Adam7+iCCP regression to compare full decode and incremental/poll decode on the same interlaced sample
  - progressive PNG/APNG chunk callbacks with typed chunk metadata
  - progressive control budgets for chunk callbacks and chunk bytes per call
  - poll/select-style progressive state helpers:
      png_decoder_poll()
      png_apng_decoder_poll()
      PNG_PROGRESSIVE_POLL_* flags
  - stable absolute chunk offsets across internal buffer compaction
  - zero-byte drain/finalize recovery when a yield happens immediately after IEND

Notable tests added:
  - test_progressive_poll_and_chunk_callbacks
  - test_apng_poll_and_chunk_callbacks
  - test_error_too_many_pixels / test_error_inflated_too_large / test_error_chunk_too_large
  - test_error_too_many_chunks / test_error_text_too_large / test_error_frame_limit
  - test_error_temp_memory_limit / test_error_work_budget / test_error_conversion_limit


Differential testing additions in this round:
  - new libpng differential harness: test_differential_libpng.c
  - curated static-PNG allowlist: differential/corpus_static_pngs.txt
  - local runners:
      differential/build_local.sh
      differential/run_local.sh
      ci/run_all_local.sh
  - GitHub Actions workflow:
      .github/workflows/differential_libpng.yml
  - compatibility checks now cover:
      * full decode vs libpng RGBA8 output
      * incremental feed_ex()/poll() decode vs libpng on the curated static-PNG allowlist, including Adam7
      * encoder smoke compatibility against libpng
      * selected metadata / unknown-chunk re-encode checks
  - palette metadata seed refreshed so the differential corpus uses a spec-conformant indexed+iCCP sample plus a separate fuzz-only hIST palette sample

Local differential result:
  DIFF_OK

Current scope notes:
  - progressive Adam7 pixel-for-pixel differential is now enabled in the libpng gate after fixing pass-to-pass predictor reset in the streaming decoder
  - valid_palette_meta.png is now spec-conformant (iCCP before PLTE) and participates in the libpng differential allowlist
